title: Grateful Dead Live at Electric Factory on 1969-02-15
lineage: Cassette (Nakamichi Dragon) > DAT (Panasonic SV-3800/48k) DAT (Sony PCM-R700) > Sound Forge > CD > FLAC

ai_review.summary: Remastered soundboard tape delivers a solid 1969 show with The Eleven highlighted, offering good audio quality despite the first‑gen cassette source.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the performance, noting it stands among the best recordings of the period and singling out The Eleven as a key moment. Although the source is a first‑generation cassette, Miller’s remaster keeps the sound clear enough to enjoy, with only the usual tape‑cut artifacts one might expect.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong musical praise (70% weight) combined with a generally good remastered soundboard recording (30% weight) yields an overall rating in the high‑four range.

recording_quality.technical_notes: First‑generation cassette source; Miller’s remaster restores clarity, though minor tape‑cut artifacts may be present.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Specific set flow not detailed, but reviewers imply the concert flows well enough to rank among the era's best.
